title: A Louis Armstrong record that brings gooseflesh
summary: They discuss a favorite Armstrong record.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Did you ever hear the record that Louie
Did I ever hear it? I've got it memorized. That is one of the most beautiful --
Isn't that. If anybody can listen to that, when Louis sings that solo, without crying, I don't know what kind of soul they have in them.
I don't even have to put it on. My wife puts it on all the time. She loves it.
But that bears out what you were saying, your blood can run cold.

You mention it and I'm getting gooseflesh when you mention the name of that thing. And they just reissued it. It's out again. You can get it again. In fact, I got it again because my original one was worn out. If you really want to learn phrasing and how to play beautifully, you don't need to buy much more than that one record. Between the two of them.
